_comment: Union-of-extremes capture (no composite score). A seed is KEPT if it lands in ANY enabled per-metric tail: value <= lo (low tail) OR value >= hi (high tail). A null bound disables that tail. Thresholds are raw metric values, set from each distribution's percentiles (~0.05%/tail unless noted). The stored `score` column is the tail-match COUNT — how many metrics the seed is extreme in — for sorting. `moons` is derived (npm − npl). Read by score.js, score.zig, scripts/plot_distributions.py; the generator picks it up via SCORE_CONFIG.
